speaker_title: Address by Mr. Imran Khan, Prime Minister of the Islamic Republic of Pakistan

paragraphs.raw_text:
Mr. 
President,

paragraphs.text: I am honoured to address the United Nations General Assembly once again.
paragraphs.raw_text: I am honoured to address the United Nations General Assembly once again.

paragraphs.text: I congratulate His Excellency Mr. Volkan Bozkir on his election as the President of the seventy-fifth session of the General Assembly.
paragraphs.raw_text:
I congratulate His Excellency Mr. Volkan Bozkir on his election as the 
President of the seventy-fifth session of the General Assembly.

paragraphs.text: We also appreciate the skilful leadership of the outgoing President, His Excellency Tijjani Muhammad-Bande, especially during the COVID-19 crisis.
paragraphs.raw_text:
We also appreciate the skilful leadership of the outgoing President, His 
Excellency Tijjani Muhammad-Bande, especially during the COVID-19 crisis.

paragraphs.text: We commend the leadership of Secretary-General António Guterres in these turbulent times.
paragraphs.raw_text:
We commend the leadership of Secretary-General António Guterres in these 
turbulent times.

paragraphs.text: Mr. President,
paragraphs.raw_text: Mr. President,

paragraphs.text: Since my government assumed office, our consistent effort has been to fundamentally transform Pakistan.
paragraphs.raw_text:
Since my government assumed office, our consistent effort has been to 
fundamentally transform Pakistan.

paragraphs.text: We envisage ‘Naya Pakistan’ to be modelled on the principles of the State of Madinah, established by our Holy Prophet (PBUH).
paragraphs.raw_text:
We envisage ‘Naya Pakistan’ to be modelled on the principles of the State of 
Madinah, established by our Holy Prophet (PBUH).

paragraphs.text: A just and humane society where all Government policies are directed at lifting our citizens out of poverty and creating a just and equitable dispensation.
paragraphs.raw_text:
A just and humane society where all Government policies are directed at lifting 
our citizens out of poverty and creating a just and equitable dispensation.

paragraphs.text: To achieve this goal, we need to have peace and stability. Thus our foreign policy aims to have peace with our neighbours and settle disputes through dialogue.
paragraphs.raw_text:
To achieve this goal, we need to have peace and stability. Thus our foreign 
policy aims to have peace with our neighbours and settle disputes through dialogue.

paragraphs.text: Mr. President,
paragraphs.raw_text: Mr. President,

paragraphs.text: The 75th Anniversary of the United Nations is an extremely important milestone as this is the only body in the world that can help us achieve our goal of peace and stability in our neighbourhood. This is also a time for us to reflect whether as the United Nations we have been able to realize the promise we collectively made to our peoples.
paragraphs.raw_text:
The 75th Anniversary of the United Nations is an extremely important 
milestone as this is the only body in the world that can help us achieve our goal of 
peace and stability in our neighbourhood. This is also a time for us to reflect whether 
as the United Nations we have been able to realize the promise we collectively made 
to our peoples.

paragraphs.text: Today, the foundations of ‘world order’– non-use of or threat of unilateral force, self-determination of peoples, the sovereign equality and territorial integrity of States, non-interference in their internal affairs, international cooperation — all these ideals are being systematically eroded.
paragraphs.raw_text:
Today, the foundations of ‘world order’– non-use of or threat of unilateral 
force, self-determination of peoples, the sovereign equality and territorial integrity 
of States, non-interference in their internal affairs, international cooperation — all 
these ideals are being systematically eroded.

paragraphs.text: International agreements are being flouted and set aside.
paragraphs.raw_text: International agreements are being flouted and set aside.

paragraphs.text: Renewed great-power rivalries are leading to a new arms race.
paragraphs.raw_text: Renewed great-power rivalries are leading to a new arms race.

paragraphs.text: Conflicts are proliferating and intensifying.
paragraphs.raw_text: Conflicts are proliferating and intensifying.

paragraphs.text: Military occupation and illegal annexations are suppressing the right of human beings to self-determination.
paragraphs.raw_text:
Military occupation and illegal annexations are suppressing the right of human 
beings to self-determination.

paragraphs.text: According to respected Professor Noam Chomsky, mankind is at even a greater risk than it was before the First and Secnd World Wars in the last century because of the increased threat of nuclear war, Climate Change, and sadly the rise of authoritarian regimes. We must come together to prevent such a catastrophe.
paragraphs.raw_text:
According to respected Professor Noam Chomsky, mankind is at even a 
greater risk than it was before the First and Secnd World Wars in the last century 
because of the increased threat of nuclear war, Climate Change, and sadly the rise of 
authoritarian regimes. We must come together to prevent such a catastrophe.

paragraphs.text: We believe the driving force in international relations must be cooperation, in accordance with principles of international law, and not confrontation and force.
paragraphs.raw_text:
We believe the driving force in international relations must be cooperation, 
in accordance with principles of international law, and not confrontation and force.

paragraphs.text: We all must emphatically reaffirm our support for multilateralism.
paragraphs.raw_text: We all must emphatically reaffirm our support for multilateralism.

paragraphs.text: Mr. President,
paragraphs.raw_text: Mr. President,

paragraphs.text: The COVID-19 pandemic has illustrated the oneness of humanity. In our interconnected world, no one is safe unless everyone is safe.
paragraphs.raw_text:
The COVID-19 pandemic has illustrated the oneness of humanity. In our 
interconnected world, no one is safe unless everyone is safe.

paragraphs.text: Locking down to control the pandemic has triggered the worst recession since the GreatDepression in the last Century. This has hit the poorest countries the hardest as well as the poor in all the countries.
paragraphs.raw_text:
Locking down to control the pandemic has triggered the worst recession since 
the GreatDepression in the last Century. This has hit the poorest countries the hardest 
as well as the poor in all the countries.

paragraphs.text: In Pakistan, we realized very early on that if we imposed a strict lockdown, the type that several affluent countries had imposed, we would have more people dying of hunger than the virus.
paragraphs.raw_text:
In Pakistan, we realized very early on that if we imposed a strict lockdown, the 
type that several affluent countries had imposed, we would have more people dying 
of hunger than the virus.

paragraphs.text: Therefore, we adopted a policy of ‘smart lockdown.’ While concentrating on the virus hot-spots we opened up our agricultural sector immediately and then followed it up with the construction sector,which employed most of the people.
paragraphs.raw_text:
Therefore, we adopted a policy of ‘smart lockdown.’ While concentrating 
on the virus hot-spots we opened up our agricultural sector immediately and then 
followed it up with the construction sector,which employed most of the people.

paragraphs.text: At the same time, and this is despite financial constraints, my government deployed an unprecedented $8 billion for our health services; plussupport the poorest and most vulnerable households with direct cash payments through Ehsaas programme; and subsidies to small businesses.
paragraphs.raw_text:
At the same time, and this is despite financial constraints, my government 
deployed an unprecedented $8 billion for our health services; plussupport the 
poorest and most vulnerable households with direct cash payments through Ehsaas 
programme; and subsidies to small businesses.

paragraphs.text: Even though our ‘smart lockdown’ was heavily criticized in the beginning, but thanks to Almighty Allah’s Grace, we have not only managed to control the virus, stabilize our economy, but most importantly, we have been able to protect the poorest segment of the society from the worst fall out of the lock down.
paragraphs.raw_text:
Even though our ‘smart lockdown’ was heavily criticized in the beginning, but 
thanks to Almighty Allah’s Grace, we have not only managed to control the virus, 
stabilize our economy, but most importantly, we have been able to protect the poorest 
segment of the society from the worst fall out of the lock down.

paragraphs.text: Today, Pakistan’s response is cited among the success stories in controlling and responding to the pandemic. However, we are still not out of the woods, like no country is out of the woods today.
paragraphs.raw_text:
Today, Pakistan’s response is cited among the success stories in controlling 
and responding to the pandemic. However, we are still not out of the woods, like no 
country is out of the woods today.

paragraphs.text: Mr. President,
paragraphs.raw_text: Mr. President,

paragraphs.text: It was obvious from the outset that developing countries would need fiscal space to respond to, and recover from, the COVID-19 crisis.
paragraphs.raw_text:
It was obvious from the outset that developing countries would need fiscal 
space to respond to, and recover from, the COVID-19 crisis.

paragraphs.text: Debt relief is one of the best ways to create that fiscal space for developing countries. Therefore, in early April, I called for a “Global Initiative on Debt Relief”.
paragraphs.raw_text:
Debt relief is one of the best ways to create that fiscal space for developing 
countries. Therefore, in early April, I called for a “Global Initiative on Debt Relief”.

paragraphs.text: We appreciate the G-20’s official debt suspension initiative and the emergency and rapid financing offered by the IMF, World Bank, Asian Development Bank and UN Agencies.
paragraphs.raw_text:
We appreciate the G-20’s official debt suspension initiative and the emergency 
and rapid financing offered by the IMF, World Bank, Asian Development Bank and 
UN Agencies.

paragraphs.text: This, however, is not enough.
paragraphs.raw_text: This, however, is not enough.

paragraphs.text: The IMF has estimated that developing countries will need over $2.5 trillion to respond and recover from the crisis.
paragraphs.raw_text:
The IMF has estimated that developing countries will need over $2.5 trillion 
to respond and recover from the crisis.

paragraphs.text: The official debt suspension will need to be extended and expanded.
paragraphs.raw_text: The official debt suspension will need to be extended and expanded.

paragraphs.text: Additional debt relief measures will also be needed.
paragraphs.raw_text: Additional debt relief measures will also be needed.

paragraphs.text: Multilateral Development Banks should ensure adequate financial inflows.
paragraphs.raw_text: Multilateral Development Banks should ensure adequate financial inflows.

paragraphs.text: Rich countries have generated over ten trillion dollars to finance their own response and recovery. They should support the creation of at least $500 billion in new Special Drawing Rights for the developing world.
paragraphs.raw_text:
Rich countries have generated over ten trillion dollars to finance their own 
response and recovery. They should support the creation of at least $500 billion in 
new Special Drawing Rights for the developing world.

paragraphs.text: Mr. President,
paragraphs.raw_text: Mr. President,

paragraphs.text: In my address to the General Assembly last year, I had highlighted the tremendous damage that illicit financial flows from developing countries to rich countries and offshore tax havens cause. This leads to the impoverishment of the developing nations. Money that could be used towards human development is siphoned off by corrupt elites.The loss of foreign exchange causes currency depreciation that in turn leads to inflation and poverty.
paragraphs.raw_text:

paragraphs.text: Mr. President,
paragraphs.raw_text: Mr. President,

paragraphs.text: If this phenomena is unaddressed, it will continue to accentuate the inequality between the rich and the poor nations, and eventually will spark off a far bigger global crisis than the present migration issue poses.
paragraphs.raw_text:
If this phenomena is unaddressed, it will continue to accentuate the inequality

paragraphs.text: The rich states cannot hold forth on human rights and justice when they provide sanctuary to money launderers’ and their lootedwealth and protection of their person.
paragraphs.raw_text:
The rich states cannot hold forth on human rights and justice when they provide

paragraphs.text: There are robust anti-Money Laundering and anti-Terrorist Financing regimes. I call upon this Assembly to take the lead in efforts to build a global framework to stem the illicit financial flows and ensure speedy repatriation of stolen wealth.
paragraphs.raw_text:

paragraphs.text: It is important to realize that the aid that flows from rich countries to the developing world is miniscule compared to the massive out-flows by our corrupt elites.
paragraphs.raw_text:

paragraphs.text: Mr. President,
paragraphs.raw_text: Mr. President,

paragraphs.text: This year, I must again reiterate the threat posed to mankind due to
paragraphs.raw_text: This year, I must again reiterate the threat posed to mankind due to

paragraphs.text: Climate Change. Unprecedented fires in Australia, Siberia, California, Brazil; unprecedented flooding in various parts of the world; and record temperatures even in the Arctic Circle. This should make us all worried for our future generations.
Commitments made through the Paris Agreement must be fulfilled, in particular the commitment to mobilize $100 billion annually as climate finance.
paragraphs.raw_text:
Commitments made through the Paris Agreement must be fulfilled, in

paragraphs.text: Pakistan’s contribution to carbon emissions is minimal, but it is one of those countries most affected by climate change. Yet, we have decided to take the lead as we consider addressing climate change a universal responsibility.
paragraphs.raw_text:
Pakistan’s contribution to carbon emissions is minimal, but it is one of those

paragraphs.text: We have launched an extremely ambitious programme to plant 10 billion trees in next three years as our contribution to mitigating the effects of climate change.
paragraphs.raw_text:
We have launched an extremely ambitious programme to plant 10 billion trees

paragraphs.text: Mr. President,
paragraphs.raw_text: Mr. President,

paragraphs.text: The pandemic was an opportunity to bring humanity together.
paragraphs.raw_text: The pandemic was an opportunity to bring humanity together.

paragraphs.text: Unfortunately, it has instead fanned nationalism, increased global tensions, and given rise to racial and religious hatred and violence against vulnerable minorities in several places.

paragraphs.text: Mr. President,
paragraphs.raw_text: Mr. President,

paragraphs.text: For over 72 years, India has illegally occupied Jammu and Kashmir against the wishes of the Kashmiri people, and in blatant violation of the resolutions of the Security Council and indeed its own commitments.
paragraphs.raw_text:

paragraphs.text: On 5th August last year, India illegally and unilaterally sought to change the status of the occupied territories and deployed additional troops, bringing the total number to 900,000, to impose a military siege on 8 million Kashmiris. All Kashmiri political leaders were incarcerated; about 13,000 Kashmiri youth were abducted and thousands tortured; a complete curfew was imposed, accompanied by a total communications blackout.

paragraphs.raw_text: Mr. President,

paragraphs.raw_text: Mr. President,

paragraphs.raw_text:
Through the Intra-Afghan Negotiations that commenced on 12 September, 
they must work out an inclusive, broad-based and comprehensive political settlement. 
The process must be Afghan-led and Afghan-owned, and without any interference or 
outside influence.

paragraphs.text: Early return of Afghan refugees must be a part of the politicalsolution. After almost two decades of war, it is imperative not to allow “spoilers” — within and outside Afghanistan — to subvert the peace process.
paragraphs.raw_text:
Early return of Afghan refugees must be a part of the politicalsolution. After 
almost two decades of war, it is imperative not to allow “spoilers” — within and 
outside Afghanistan — to subvert the peace process.

paragraphs.text: Peace and stability in Afghanistan will open new opportunities for development and regional connectivity.New vistas of cooperation could emerge with Central Asia and beyond.
paragraphs.raw_text:
Peace and stability in Afghanistan will open new opportunities for development 
and regional connectivity.New vistas of cooperation could emerge with Central Asia 
and beyond.

paragraphs.text: Mr. President,
paragraphs.raw_text: Mr. President,

paragraphs.text: Palestine remains a ‘festering wound’. A just and lasting settlement is indispensable, for the Middle East and the world. Illegal annexations of Palestinian territory, the building of illegal settlements and the imposition of inhuman living conditions on the Palestinian people especially in Gaza cannot bring peace to a troubled region.
paragraphs.raw_text:
Palestine remains a ‘festering wound’. A just and lasting settlement is 
indispensable, for the Middle East and the world. Illegal annexations of Palestinian 
territory, the building of illegal settlements and the imposition of inhuman living 
conditions on the Palestinian people especially in Gaza cannot bring peace to a 
troubled region.

paragraphs.text: Pakistan continues to support a two-state solution — in line with UN General Assembly and Security Council resolutions, within the internationally agreed parameters, pre-1967 borders, and Al-Quds Al-Sharif as the Capital of a united, contiguous and independent Palestinian state.
paragraphs.raw_text:
Pakistan continues to support a two-state solution — in line with UN General 
Assembly and Security Council resolutions, within the internationally agreed 
parameters, pre-1967 borders, and Al-Quds Al-Sharif as the Capital of a united, 
contiguous and independent Palestinian state.

paragraphs.text: Mr. President,
paragraphs.raw_text: Mr. President,

paragraphs.text: The United Nations remains the best legitimate avenue for collective action — in managing international conflicts, fostering peace and security, promoting equitable development and addressing global problems.
paragraphs.raw_text:
The United Nations remains the best legitimate avenue for collective action — 
in managing international conflicts, fostering peace and security, promoting equitable 
development and addressing global problems.

paragraphs.text: I urge the Secretary-General to take the lead in preventing global conflicts.
paragraphs.raw_text: I urge the Secretary-General to take the lead in preventing global conflicts.

paragraphs.text: He should convene Summit-level meetings to address regional hot spots and resolve outstanding disputes.
paragraphs.raw_text:
He should convene Summit-level meetings to address regional hot spots and 
resolve outstanding disputes.

paragraphs.text: The United Nations should be made fully responsive to the challenges of our times. A comprehensive reform of the United Nations, including the Security Council, is essential to promote greater democracy, accountability, transparency and efficiency.
paragraphs.raw_text:
The United Nations should be made fully responsive to the challenges of 
our times. A comprehensive reform of the United Nations, including the Security 
Council, is essential to promote greater democracy, accountability, transparency 

and efficiency.

paragraphs.text: Pakistan will continue to participate actively in this process and endeavour, with other Member States, to build a world where conflict is outlawed and equitable prosperity for all pursued in conditions of peace and security.
paragraphs.raw_text:
Pakistan will continue to participate actively in this process and endeavour, 
with other Member States, to build a world where conflict is outlawed and equitable 
prosperity for all pursued in conditions of peace and security.

paragraphs.text: I thank you.
paragraphs.raw_text: I thank you.
